source_logic: Original conjecture asserts a universal upper bound and an additional sharpness clause. A faithful violation of the explicit upper bound refutes the conjunction without choosing a formal reading of its underspecified sharpness sentence. No truth of a specific numerical instance is assumed by this gate.
required_scope: Ordinary finite pure integer linear program with explicit integral input, genuine integer feasible set and real relaxation.
Attained unique integer and relaxed optima, including a relaxation vertex, to cover ordinary selection conventions.
n equals the number of decision coordinates in each stated representation.
Delta accounts for all finite numerical constraint, RHS, objective and bound data in that representation; it is not silently replaced by a determinant parameter.
Actual coordinate infinity distance between genuine optimizers.
Explicitly identified ordinary equality/inequality and variable-domain forms must account for their own variables, data and optima. No claim of invariance under arbitrary padded encodings.
A final formal disproof must falsify the original explicit universal bound, not merely establish an unrelated estimate or an abstract tuple disconnected from optimization.
limitations: This qualifies a disproof task; it does not certify any construction or completed proof and does not resolve all possible sharpness interpretations.
